non_destructive_boundary.interpretation: This supplement records the observed implementation and unresolved operational design state. It neither overwrites nor approves the predecessor design canon.

allowed: Repository code and policy establish the enumerated implementation defaults, fail-closed branches, approved capacity/retention values and provisional engineering budgets.
Eight versioned admin/gateway telemetry producer events and their closed allowlists are internally implemented and unit verified.
The 35-day backup-prune CLI default and boundary behavior are internally unit verified.
Provisional W4 performance budgets and W8 recovery tiers are NOT_APPROVED and NOT_RUN.
prohibited: Any provisional PB-* or T0/T1/T2 value is an approved requirement, SLA or measured PASS.
Telemetry collector, persistent retention, dashboard, alert delivery or production monitoring is complete.
A production backup, prune, restore, fault injection, failover, load, actual-device or deployment test passed.
Actual RTO/RPO, zero loss, full-cloud budget approval or release eligibility exists.
The five design artifacts are approved, baselined or release-complete.

observed_contracts.fallback: UNSUPPORTED is LIMITED; UNKNOWN/IN_PROGRESS is BLOCKED; no metric claim from unknown evidence
observed_contracts.user_action: Use only the exposed limited/blocked startup path; do not treat timeout as distance support.

actions: LOAD_LEGACY only when unified is active and a legacy known-good is available
observed_contracts.partial_success_rule: A failed model is never replaced by fake detection.

observed_contracts.retry: No upload while walking; wait for stationary confirmation and an admitted network. Cellular additionally requires explicit opt-in.
observed_contracts.cancellation: Movement, unknown session state, tracking stop or admission-generation change closes admission and cancels active uploads.

observed_contracts.partial_success_rule: Provider/schema/priority/geometry/endpoints/guide monotonicity are validated as one response; any violation rejects the whole route.
observed_contracts.user_action: Keep the prior still-valid route or pause guidance; never use an unvalidated partial route.

observed_contracts.partial_success_rule: A duplicate candidate is retained and tagged rather than silently deleted or merged.
observed_contracts.user_action: Explicit reports announce completion/failure; missing GPS requests location; an existing candidate is disclosed.
Stable Korean recovery/retry/help messages are selected by code; rate-limited work waits for the bounded Retry-After value.

module_contracts.known_gap: Versioned six-event producer is implemented; collector, persistent retention, dashboard and production monitoring remain W9.

observed_contracts.failure_behavior: Return bounded gateway closed/timeout/unavailable responses; do not expose raw upstream error bodies.
observed_contracts.retry: Forward only validated Retry-After and bounded audit/request correlation headers where allowed.

observed_contracts.overload_behavior: 429/503 with bounded Retry-After; no unbounded concurrent upload.

observed_contracts.partial_success_rule: Overall completion is forbidden while any scoped item remains external, waiting, held or failed; retry_after and evidence_ref remain per item.
observed_contracts.integrity: Event and state ledgers are SHA-256 chained.

module_contracts.known_gap: Versioned two-event failure producer is implemented; collector, persistent retention, dashboard and production monitoring remain W9.

observed_contracts.retry: No automatic provider substitution; retry must remain bounded and must not infer a route.

observed_contracts.behavior: Bounded 429/503/timeout envelopes include stable public code/type and a short Retry-After where configured; raw internal path/exception text is not a client contract.

observed_contracts.partial_success_rule: Journal/reconciliation and exclusive transaction locking prevent a DB-only or object-only state from being silently promoted to completion.

dependency_contracts.fallback: Retain only a still-current validated route in its limited validity context or pause route guidance.
dependency_contracts.retry_and_resync: Retry only after explicit current request/selection; store a new validated route version.

dependency_contracts.dependency: GPS/ARCore metric depth and device sensors
dependency_contracts.timeout: metric-depth preflight 10 seconds; other supplier SLA not applicable/unresolved
dependency_contracts.fallback: Use only the declared limited capability tier or stop metric/turn/local steering outputs.
prohibited: derive trusted distance from unknown depth
dependency_contracts.retry_and_resync: Re-run current capability and freshness gates; never silently resume a prior walk.

dependency_contracts.fallback: TalkBack interaction, bounded screen/help surfaces and policy-allowed haptic cues; safety-critical channel loss can stop dependent outputs.
prohibited: let dialogue delay a higher-priority risk warning
dependency_contracts.retry_and_resync: Recheck engine and require an explicit safe resume path.

detection: three consecutive runtime failures by default
dependency_contracts.timeout: backend warmed inference 2 seconds default and startup 30 seconds default; Android device SLA unresolved
dependency_contracts.fallback: Load a verified legacy known-good only when available; otherwise disable detection.
dependency_contracts.retry_and_resync: Reset failure count only after success; revalidate model/config generation.

dependency_contracts.fallback: Keep independent on-device detection/risk/TTS functions where their own gates remain valid and queue server-bound work.
prohibited: make real-time safety depend on a server round trip
dependency_contracts.retry_and_resync: On connectivity, revalidate session/consent/network/capacity version and retransmit by stable identity/idempotency contract.

dependency_contracts.fallback: Keep an eligible item in the bounded phone queue for at most the policy window; hold new material under capacity policy.
prohibited: mark complete from DB metadata alone
dependency_contracts.retry_and_resync: Completion only after full object receipt/digest; reconcile by stable ID after recovery.

dependency_contracts.fallback: Block original upload while walking; stationary Wi-Fi is allowed, stationary cellular requires explicit opt-in, otherwise wait/fail closed.
prohibited: upload original activity data while walking
treat unknown transport or motion as stationary
dependency_contracts.retry_and_resync: Re-evaluate motion, consent and the actual selected network immediately before transfer; cancel if movement resumes.

report_upload_retry_contract.verification_boundary: Actual fault injection and actual network/device testing remain NOT_RUN.

dependency_contracts.fallback: Block protected server/admin operations while preserving independent local safety behavior when otherwise eligible.
dependency_contracts.retry_and_resync: Reauthenticate or follow the explicit recovery action; revalidate actor and high-risk state before commit.

artifacts.global_recovery_rule: After any dependency recovers, re-check current permission, consent, capability, route, safety and user-confirmation state. Do not automatically resume a previous walk or route.
